title: Show the network routing table
summary: Display the system's routing table to see how network traffic is directed. This command shows the default gateway and other routes without resolving IP addresses to hostnames for faster output.

steps.explain: Run netstat with flags to print the routing table (-r) and avoid resolving IP addresses to hostnames (-n), which makes the output faster and cleaner.

alternatives.explain: Show only the IPv4 routing table.
